description: Two separately useful goals with an accepted shared contract, fixtures, and partial producer implementation.

files.docs/contracts.md:
# Accepted result contract
A stored run record has task_id, attempt_id, outcome, artifact_refs. outcome is success or failure. Evidence is referenced, not copied. This contract was accepted by the human.
files.docs/progress.md:
# Current work
Goal A: normalize run records for existing systems. Contract and fixtures agreed; producer implementation partial.
Goal B: add independent reevaluation of stored records. It must not rerun agents. No implementation yet.
Both capabilities are independently useful, and together must allow producer output to be reevaluated.

acceptance: Organizes related processes with output-specific dependencies, reuses existing agreements, advances ready design/local work, and requires real integrated evidence for overall delivery. No file changes.
